author: Homeomorph
quote: Directly attempting to set legacy properties like C0, C1, Part0, or Part1 on an AnimationConstraint will throw an error. They rely entirely on Attachments.
capture_method: Read-only research worker directly inspected the primary post in the cloud browser DOM/accessibility tree and observed the Roblox Staff badge; this file is a short observation record, not an HTML/screenshot archive.
date_verification: Post date cross-checked against the indexed primary post body and browser display.
scope: AJU-enabled rigs using AnimationConstraint; legacy property writes are not an equivalent attachment migration.
limitations: Conditional on AJU-enabled rigs; this does not instruct converting every rig or changing Motor6D semantics.
